descriptionChirho: Loops or fastening rings used in the construction of the tabernacle curtains, serving as attachment points where clasps join curtain sets together. All occurrences refer to the same concrete textile element in Exodus 26 and 36; variation is purely grammatical — absolute plural (eng: loops, spa: lazos, hin: फन्दे, arb: عُروَةً, kor: 고리들을, swa: vitanzi) versus prepositional 'into the loops' (eng: into the loops, spa: en los lazos, hin: फंदों में, arb: في العُرى).
